_readme: Update manifest for the Spectdrum plugin, fetched by the plugin over raw.githubusercontent.com. This repo holds ONLY this file and release binaries, never source code.
_how_it_works: The plugin shows its update banner only when "version" here is HIGHER than the running build (numeric per-segment compare). While it stays below every shipped build nobody is ever prompted, which is the intended idle state.
_to_publish_an_update: 1) attach the installers to a GitHub Release in THIS repo; 2) point url_win / url_mac at those release assets; 3) only THEN raise "version". Raising it before the files exist prompts every customer to download something that is not there.
_platform_keys: url_win / url_mac are picked by the plugin at compile time; plain "url" is the fallback for either. Until round 142 there was a single url, so a Mac customer would have been handed the Windows .exe.
notes: The first step is no longer swallowed when playback starts or restarts
Starting playback at bar one no longer sounds the pattern's last step first, and the playhead no longer flashes it (Cubase)
Starting playback from any bar other than the first no longer sounds the previous step late and doubles the downbeat (Cubase)
Starting playback from bar three or later no longer loses the first beat (Reaper)
Pressing play part-way into a step now waits for the next step instead of sounding the one already passed
Restarting from the beginning of the project no longer produces a double hit on the first step
A loop that wraps part-way through a buffer keeps its downbeat
The step playhead no longer flashes the last step at the moment the loop turns over
The first hit after pressing play is now full: a 20 ms look-ahead lets the filters hear the audio before the hit opens (reported as latency, compensated by the host)
The first hit after loading a project is now triggered
Jumping to a far bar (250 and beyond) no longer drops the first beat in Reaper and Studio One
Dotted and triplet grids play correctly against a host loop, and a fast grid on a large buffer no longer drops hits
A grid change made with the transport stopped no longer swallows the first step of the next play
The analyser's colours now follow the band that is actually sounding, and the LINK button reads clearly as lit
Secondary text is brighter in both skins, so captions and values stay readable on large high-resolution displays
Dragging across steps to set velocity now works in both directions: dragging back removes the steps you passed
The preset browser closes when you click anywhere outside it
A pending delete confirmation no longer lingers after switching patterns
